verdict.rationale: Pandoc is a markup and document conversion tool covering formats such as Markdown, HTML, LaTeX and docx. Audio/video transcoding with codec, bitrate and resolution control belongs to a different product category (media transcoders), so this axis does not apply. Nothing in the evidence shows Pandoc ships any media transcoding capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As a power user, audio and video transcode between formats with control over codec, bitrate, and resolution
